status: Workbench v1 Ready — bounded local research scope

supported.discovery: 54 retained techniques, six original inventory phases; frozen capability/release/profile/source catalogs, rights and limitations inspectable
supported.invocation: All 54 native sample paths verified through backend hashes and real browser form execution; registered native operations remain subject to their original support boundaries
supported.forms: Native legacy CLI descriptors, typed nested sample fields, repeatable lists, sample/reset/validation/run and advanced JSON; examples do not define complete schemas
supported.records: Pseudonymous consent scopes and technique allowlists, cases, linked sessions/notes, local SQLite migration/transactions/stable IDs and idempotency
supported.blind: Server-hidden separate answers, frozen inputs/results, immutable interpretations, reveal after lock, shuffled alternative labels and descriptive assessor feedback
supported.prospective: Server-issued future #51 binary event form, fixed-half baseline, unchanged Lab chronology/admission/replay and independent outcome evidence
supported.advanced_plans: Guarded native Lab #49/#51/#57 plans; creation/selection/issuance stamped by server, future cutoff required
supported.outcomes: Pending, resolved, missing/excluded native outcomes; append-only void/disputed/correction annotations suspend scoring without replacing history
supported.comparison: All runs descriptively; compatible undisputed Lab studies quantitatively, using matched eligible outcomes only
supported.dashboard: Actual local case/session/sample/submission/outcome/eligibility/missing/abstention/rejection counts and per-study native baseline/calibration reports; technique/study/participant/creation-time filters
supported.portability: Exact-text JSON public-record export/import with commitments, independent native replay for newly imported sessions, conflict/duplicate rejection; CSV/Markdown summaries and Markdown result export
supported.deletion: Participant/case cascading deletion, secrets removal, separately consented frozen retention, explicit preview; direct deletion of unlinked runs/forecasts
supported.locality: Loopback-only FastAPI/static UI, trusted-host/origin guards, no analytics, external data fetches, photo uploads, remote inference or arbitrary kernel/file overrides

experimental.human_studies: User declarations and locally recorded outcomes are not independently authenticated or empirical skill certification
experimental.blinding: Workflow concealment only; operator must prevent semantic leakage from native inputs/results; database owner can inspect secrets

unsupported: Numeric historical outcome replacement/recomputed corrected scores; annotations preserve originals and suspend scoring

Universal symbolic accuracy/probability, model blending across incompatible contracts, independent effective sample sizes or superiority certification
External timestamp authentication, external assessor authentication, encryption at rest, multi-user isolation or hosted deployment
Unrevealed secret portability, erasure of separately downloaded exports/backups or physical forensic erasure
